name: neon-gradient-card
blurb: Card with animated neon gradient border that cycles continuously.
description: Wraps children in a neon-glowing card container with a gradient border that rotates through two colours in a looping animation. Dimensions are measured on mount and resize.
use_when: A hero card or featured container that needs to command attention with cyberpunk-styled motion.
avoid_when: Minimalist designs or when constant animation would be distracting.
